name: Fintech Linear Algebra Expansion Inventory
summary: Provider refinements for tridiagonal solvers, covariance updates, and matrix-weighted portfolio CDGs.

operations.name: Check Matrix Conditioning
operations.intent: Detect ill-conditioned pricing or covariance systems before factorization.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add a matrix conditioning check before solving or factorizing.

rewrite.before_summary: Matrix factorization starts from raw coefficients.
rewrite.after_summary: A conditioning check is inserted before factorization.

operations.name: Validate Decomposition Accuracy
operations.intent: Validate matrix decomposition residuals used by covariance or solver steps.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add a residual check after matrix factorization.

rewrite.after_summary: A decomposition-accuracy validation is inserted after factorization.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds reconstruction-error evidence for the factorization.

operations.name: Detect Rank Deficiency
operations.intent: Identify singular or rank-deficient covariance systems before solving.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add a rank check before solving a matrix system.

rewrite.before_summary: Solve stages may consume rank-deficient inputs.
rewrite.after_summary: A rank-deficiency detector is inserted before solve or transform.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds matrix-rank evidence before downstream allocation or pricing logic.

operations.name: Monitor Iterative Convergence
operations.intent: Detect stalled residual convergence after an iterative linear solve.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add a residual-convergence check after solving.

rewrite.before_summary: Solver output flows downstream without residual-rate evidence.
rewrite.after_summary: An iterative-convergence monitor is inserted after solve or transform.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds residual-decay evidence for solver reliability.

audit.rationale: Fintech pricing, covariance, and portfolio atoms include matrix solve and transformation contexts.
audit.dejargonized_summary: These checks make matrix pipelines report conditioning, factorization accuracy, rank, and residual convergence.
uncertainty_notes: CDG mappings identify plausible fintech contexts; trigger semantics mirror matcher diagnostics.
